details:
Q1. What specifically should be improved?
Choices:
A. One workflow or script — name the exact file(s) or phase (RECOMMENDED)
B. One prompt or documentation surface — name the exact file(s)
C. A cross-cutting pipeline behavior — name the affected workflows/scripts
D. Other — describe the exact feature/path to change
Q2. What is the current problem with it?
Choices:
A. It is failing or behaving incorrectly — include the observed behavior, error, or run/log reference (RECOMMENDED)
B. It works, but is too slow, noisy, or expensive — name the step and the pain point
C. A capability is missing — describe the missing behavior
D. The docs/operator guidance is unclear or outdated — name the section and what is wrong
Q3. What outcome should this change deliver?
Choices:
A. A minimal fix for one concrete problem, preserving existing behavior otherwise (RECOMMENDED)
B. An improvement to one measurable metric — name the metric/target
C. Specific docs/tests/contracts updates that codify the intended behavior
D. Other — state the acceptance criteria clearly
